basic_info.description: Now Priced to sell! Experience breathtaking views at One Rincon Hill in Unit #3401, the premier East Facing (01 Floor Plan) one-bedroom, one-bath residence with an additional office alcove. This unit offers superior interior upgrades beyond the standard finish package provided by the developer. Situated on the 34th floor, it boasts expansive double-pane windows that provide stunning panoramic water views during the day and dazzling views of the Bay Bridge at night. This sophisticated and stylish home features hardwood floors, custom lighting, a designer bathroom with unique customizations, and blackout window shades. Situated within a vibrant community, you'll be steps away from major tech headquarters like Google, Facebook, and LinkedIn, as well as the Transbay Terminal, various restaurants, grocery stores, and shops. Residents at One Rincon Hill enjoy access to a range of amenities, including two fitness centers and two hospitality rooms, featuring Uncle Harry's penthouse lounge located at The Harrison. Live, work, and play in one of San Francisco's most coveted addresses.
